candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502 with p95 ~2425ms.
candidates.uncertainty: No Redis-side metrics/logs; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation, network, or inventory client config is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show repeated redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway checkout 502; gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs showing the reserve_inventory timeout cause
Dependency operation outcome metrics for gateway/inventory (empty series)
